title: Iqhinga Eligqunyiweyo
intro: Uzifumana ukho phambi komntu onamandla ukususela kwimihla yesambulo. Lo mntu wayesaziwa ngengqondo yakhe, ubutyebi bakhe, kunye nesikhundla sakhe phakathi kwabantu bakhe. Xa kwafika imiqondiso ecacileyo, bayibona ubuhle kodwa bakhetha ukungathobeli kunokuzithoba. Yintoni eyaqhuba lo mphefumlo ukuba ucebe ebumnyameni, kwaye yayiyintoni isiphelo sakhe sokugqibela?
clues: Ndisikelelwe ngezixhobo ezininzi kunye nempembelelo, nto leyo eyenza ilizwi lam laba nzima kwiintlanganiso.
Xa amazwi kaThixo ayephindaphindwa, andizange ndikwazi ukukhanyela ubuchule bawo bokuthetha, kodwa ikratshi lam alizange lindivumele ukuba ndizithobe.
Ndaqokelela abacebisi bam, ndazahlula ukuze ndicinge ngendlela yokungcolisa umyalezo.
Emva kokucingisisa kakhulu, ndathi yinto nje 'engumlingo odluliselwe kwixesha elidlulileyo' wokugxotha abantu.
Esi sityhilelo sabhekisa kum ngqo sisithi: ‘Ndishiyeni nalo ndimdalileyo ndedwa.’ Ndakhethwa ngenxa yeqhinga lam.
Kungekudala, kanye loo mlilo endalumkiswa ngawo uza kundibamba ngentloko, kwaye andiyi kuba nandlela yokusinda.
